core_job: For online shoppers who already get promo codes (newsletters, receipts, influencer posts, texts) and lose them: save a received code in seconds by pasting the whole message, then at checkout get the best code you hold for this store and this cart, copied and ready to paste. Everything runs on the device. There is no code feed, no backend and no account. Today the app has no data source at all: kDefaultBaseUrl is empty (lib/core/network/trpc_client.dart:14), so every screen shows 'Deals service unavailable' (state_panels.dart:293-295). That message was store screenshot 01 and is the 2.1(a) error Apple saw on the home page.
signature: Checkout mode. You pick a store and type the subtotal. The app ranks your own saved codes by what each one really takes off that cart: percent codes as min(subtotal x p, cap), fixed codes only once the minimum spend is met, free shipping shown separately. Expired codes and codes that failed before are excluded. It shows nudges like 'Add $7.50 to unlock $20 off' and copies the top code in one tap. Then it asks 'Did it work?' and saves the answer, so dead codes stop being suggested. A deterministic on-device parser fills in code, discount, minimum spend, cap, expiry and store from pasted text, and the user confirms every field. Competitors were checked only by reading their App Store descriptions through the keyless iTunes API, not by using the apps. Feed apps: RetailMeNot, PayPal Honey, Rakuten, Coupert, Capital One Shopping. Wallet apps: Snip It, CouponCrowd. None of their descriptions mentions ranking your saved codes against a cart total. Web search was unavailable in this session.

M5 Own identity. Light-first carbon-copy-ticket look: background #F2F4FA, ink #141B34, seed #2B3FCB, plus status colours #E8A317 / #1F8A4C / #C2362F, with ThemeMode.system. Bundled Hanken Grotesk for UI and Martian Mono for codes. Tickets have notches and a perforation line. One wallet screen with no NavigationBar and a pinned At checkout button. Cupertino widgets and CupertinoIcons on iOS. New splash (#2B3FCB with a ticket vector, sha1 different from 3f6a9b27d8...). New full-bleed ticket icon. Delete the neon palette, ThemeMode.dark, the hero 'Find the Best Deals', 'Welcome back', premiumAdFree 'Ad-free experience', the unread accent swatches, the GitHub release-notes link and the shell-anchored AglAdBanner. If ads stay, there is one banner at the end of the wallet list only.

M6 Honest. No seeded or sample codes in lib/ or assets/. No behaviour-changing --dart-define (SCREENSHOT, API_BASE), no remote config, no region/date/reviewer detection beyond UMP. A test greps lib/ and the ARBs for 'not connected', 'unavailable', 'coming soon', 'in this build' and 'not available yet'.

M7 Proven. flutter analyze clean and flutter test green. A new release_sanity case fails if pubspec lists dio, http, supabase_flutter or speech_to_text, or Info.plist has mic/speech keys. Tests of deleted features are rewritten where the property still applies, or removed with the feature, and the commit message lists each removed file. No skips. Path-limited commit (never fastlane/), pushed to main. Launch on the simulator and screenshot the empty wallet, add-code and checkout screens.
